outcome: factors associated with opioid consumption post-discharge
cohort: A total of 283 English-speaking patients who underwent a cesarean delivery at a hospital in the US were interviewed post-discharge.
finding: Implementation of a restrictive opioid prescribing policy after cesarean delivery significantly decreased opioid prescriptions at discharge while maintaining high patient satisfaction with pain control.
mod_finding: The restrictive opioid prescription policy was effective in decreasing opioid prescriptions and maintaining high patient satisfaction with pain control for women after cesarean delivery.
